description: Split one PDF into several PDFs written to a folder: by page ranges (one file per range, e.g. "1-3, 4-6, 7-"), every N pages, or one file per page. Files are named like the website: <name>-pages-1-3.pdf, <name>-part-01.pdf, <name>-page-001.pdf. Use pdf_extract_pages to get a single PDF with chosen pages. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/pdf-split/

every.description: For mode "every": pages per file (e.g. 2 makes 1-2, 3-4…).

file.description: The PDF: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

mode.description: "ranges": one PDF per range in `ranges`; "every": a new PDF every `every` pages; "single": one PDF per page.

output.description: Folder to write the PDFs into (created if missing). Default: a new folder in the server output folder.

ranges.description: For mode "ranges": comma-separated ranges, each becomes one PDF, e.g. "1-3, 4-6, 7-".

name: pdf_split
title: Split PDF
